title: The shared-file move rule leaves out telling the sessions to rebase once the move is on main, and its test does not check it
goal: The shared-file move rule in .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md (run, Shared-file move) and kb/_self/backlog.md says the sessions are told to rebase once the move is on main, as ST-e4nkkkm2's goal states, and test_kb_cohesion's shared_file_move_problems checks that phrase with a planted copy without it. Found by the SP-tpulmoxh review.

run: import sys,re;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();b=next(l for l in t.splitlines() if 'Shared-file move' in l);sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'rebase', b) else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is the wording of the kb-sprint skill and the runbook (a missing clause), so there is no behaviour to run; the fix adds the clause and a phrase to test_kb_cohesion's shared_file_move_problems, whose planted copy without it fails
